scope: Student workflow simulations, source-data review, API/security boundaries and local migration verification. No visual browser session or million-user load test was available.

remediations.result: Published rules and named courses no longer become blanket student confirmation homework.
One short step captures prior courses, career purpose, priority and optional military records; transcripts are optional.
Indexed official program URLs prefill research without selecting unavailable templates or replacing a working plan.
Source-bound canonical aliases, exact listing identities and unfinished-course projections restore usable degree fits without inventing earned credit.
Local Worker computes build, matrix, save and fresh confirmation; superseded jobs terminate and stale results cannot replace current work.
Identity correction is available. Stale edits cannot overwrite newer quantities or approvals; changed identities lose stale catalog trust.
CU records stay editable and available for explicit evaluated placement; cross-school switches preserve original quantities.
Known native tuition informs optimization; inconsistent billing/pace assumptions prevent a complete total.
Prior WGU programs do not automatically satisfy active-program residency; sourced five-year course limits remain enforced.
Monthly catalog IDs are preserved in shared plans, reports and fingerprints. Existing evidence/flags survive migration; legacy unknown catalogs are not relabeled.
Published, conditional and university choices remain distinct; missing savings benchmarks never become zero savings.
Seven current business ledgers reviewed; five exact residency policies added. No provider equivalency was promoted by this institutional policy batch.
Signed-in students have a direct account backup action; explicit consent and version conflicts remain.
Temporary auth failures preserve sessions and return retryable503. Ready-template reads/reuse share current source and academic gates without automatic AI spend.
Only credential-free public discussion reads may use a10-second edge cache. Private, authenticated and verification reads bypass it.
A database index supports repeated degree-link lookup without scanning the template table.

The compiler applies reviewed online/residential receiving-school awards to exact named requirements before considering weaker inherited candidates. Healthcare and residential accounting gains were verified without individual awards.

verification.automatedFlowChecks: Passed focused actual-closure, pure-engine, Worker protocol/freshness and API suites; source credits, original private records and school approval controls retained.
verification.migrationChecks: Monthly catalog migration preserves evidence, flags, unique scopes and foreign keys; URL index is additive.
verification.v47LiveVerification: Published assets match committed source; real Liberty and WGU link results, private401 boundaries and email/Google/Claude configuration confirmed without paid AI calls.

remainingWork.item: UMPI current degree/GEC allocation and alternative-credit policy conflicts remain held; no complete plan is invented.
Directory coverage and full requirement ledgers are broader than independently verified accelerated course maps. Continue school/provider-specific mapping review.
WGU Supply Chain/Project Management title defects and Accounting/IT Management capstone applicability remain explicitly held.
Before large-scale partner/student rollout: load testing, read/auth latency measurement, scheduled template refresh/demotion, monetary AI spend reporting and paginated organization discovery.
Student reviews and real outcome evidence must grow from actual participants; do not fabricate ratings or verification.

cacheVisibilityTradeoff: Edited or removed public discussions may remain visible to anonymous readers for up to10seconds. Authenticated moderation and verification are uncached.
